This workdir holds a small plugin package under `plugins/`. Every module in it declares exactly one top-level `CAPABILITY = "<token>"`. Read `NAMING_RULE.md` for the exact naming rule and the registry task, then do BOTH of the following. (1) Build the registry: create `registry.py` at the repo root (the same directory as NAMING_RULE.md, the parent of `plugins/`) defining a single top-level dict `REGISTRY` that maps each module's stem (filename without `.py`, e.g. `plug_alpha`) to that module's CAPABILITY token, for ALL modules in the package — there are several of them, so make sure you collect EVERY one. (2) Fix the one violator: exactly one module's CAPABILITY breaks the naming rule (it must be lowercase snake_case starting with `cap_`); edit that module so its CAPABILITY equals the canonicalized value (lowercase every letter, replace each `-` with `_`), and record that FIXED value in the registry. When you're done, `registry.REGISTRY` must agree with what every module actually declares on disk and every value must satisfy the rule. Reading all the modules is the bulk of the work — feel free to delegate the breadth (e.g. to read-only explorer subagents) or read them yourself; either way, be complete and exact.
